cases.prompt: I just ran install.sh and installed the MDA AI skills. Help me configure them.
cases.expected_behavior: Agent detects installed skills by scanning sibling skill directories, reads each skill's docs/setup.md, finds template files in each skill's templates/ directory, auto-resolves placeholders where possible, asks user only for unknown values, shows full configured file for approval before writing.
assertions: Agent scans sibling skill directories for installed skills
Agent reads docs/setup.md for each skill
Agent locates template files in each skill's templates/ directory
Agent attempts to auto-resolve placeholder values before asking the user
Agent asks user only for placeholders that could not be resolved
Agent shows complete configured file and waits for explicit user approval before writing
Agent scans for remaining {{ patterns after saving and repeats if any found

cases.expected_behavior: Agent activates skills-config skill and begins configuration walk-through.
assertions: Agent uses skills-config skill
Agent does not attempt to install or reinstall skills
Agent focuses on filling in template files only

cases.expected_behavior: Agent queries the ADO MCP server to resolve org URL, project name, and repository ID without asking the user.
assertions: Agent detects connected ADO MCP server
Agent uses MCP tools to resolve organization URL, project name, repository ID
Agent does not ask the user for values that were resolved via MCP
Agent only asks for values that MCP could not provide

cases.context: pr-generator-config.md is already fully configured in the skill's templates/ directory
cases.expected_behavior: Agent reuses already-filled values (e.g. MCP_SERVER_NAME, ORGANIZATION_URL) when configuring other skills, without asking the user to re-enter them.
assertions: Agent reads already-configured template files
Agent reuses matching values across skills
Agent does not ask user for values already present in other configs

cases.expected_behavior: Agent shows the complete configured file to the user and waits for explicit approval before writing. If user requests changes, agent applies them and re-shows before saving.
assertions: Agent shows full configured file before writing
Agent waits for explicit user approval
Agent does not write the file without approval
Agent re-shows file after changes and waits for approval again

cases.prompt: I think I filled in all the config values, can you check?
cases.expected_behavior: Agent scans template files for remaining {{ patterns and reports any that are still unfilled.
assertions: Agent scans template files for {{ tokens
Agent reports any remaining placeholders by name
Agent offers to help fill in missing values
